meaning:
παρα-καλύπτω
[in LXX: Isa.44:8 (פָּחַד), Eze.22:26 (עָלַם hi.)* ;]
to cover by hanging something beside, to hide: metaphorically (as Plat., al.), Luk.9:45.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: But they didn’t understand this saying. It was concealed from them, that they should not perceive it, and they were afraid to ask him about this saying.
